title_zh: 写了代码，不等于做了事
outcome_en: You can ask whether code was only written, or also run.
outcome_zh: 你能追问：它只是写好了，还是已经运行过。

blocks.body_en: An agent says: "I wrote a script." Good. But your first judgment is not "is it smart?" It is: did anything run?
blocks.body_zh: agent 说："I wrote a script."（我写了一个脚本。）很好。但你先别急着判断它聪不聪明，先问一句：它运行过吗？

blocks.anchor_en: A recipe card. It describes every step of a dish precisely, but the card itself is just text — nothing gets cooked until a cook follows it.
blocks.anchor_zh: 一张菜谱。它精确写下每个步骤，但菜谱本身只是文字——没有厨师照着做，菜就不会出现。
blocks.explain_en: Source code is the text of a program: instructions stored in an ordinary file. `hello.py` is source code the way `recipe.txt` is a recipe: readable, editable, and still not action.
blocks.explain_zh: 源代码就是程序的文字版：指令存在一个普通文件里。`hello.py` 是源代码，就像 `菜谱.txt` 是菜谱：能读，能改，但还没有变成动作。

blocks.title_en: A Python file is still just text
blocks.title_zh: Python 文件先是一张文字稿
blocks.caption_en: First judgment: this is a file, not proof that anything ran.
blocks.caption_zh: 第一层判断：这是文件，不是运行证据。
blocks.alt_en: A small code editor window named hello.py, showing two lines of Python source code.
blocks.alt_zh: 一个名为 hello.py 的代码编辑窗口，里面有两行 Python 源代码。

blocks.anchor_en: Cooking the dish. The recipe (code) sits there until something actually performs its steps, one by one, in order.
blocks.anchor_zh: 开火做菜。菜谱（代码）一直只是纸，直到有人真的照着步骤一步步做出来。
blocks.explain_en: To run (execute) a program is to make the computer perform the instructions. Writing and running are separate moments. "I wrote it" is not the same claim as "I ran it."
blocks.explain_zh: 运行（执行）程序，就是让电脑真的照着指令做。写代码和运行代码是两个时刻。"I wrote it"（我写好了）和 "I ran it"（我运行过了）不是同一个承诺。

blocks.body_en: In collaboration, this distinction saves time. If the agent only wrote code, ask to see the plan. If it ran code, ask what changed.
blocks.body_zh: 协作时，这个区别很省时间。agent 只是写了代码，你就看计划；它已经运行过，你就追问改动了什么。

blocks.body_en: Advanced question: now read a status update as evidence, not as vibes.
blocks.body_zh: 举一反三：现在把一句进度汇报当成证据读，不要只听语气。

blocks.body_en: Checkpoint: code file or completed action? Ask that before you judge the quality of the work.
blocks.body_zh: 小结：代码文件，还是已经完成的动作？先问这个，再判断工作质量。

exercises.prompt_en: A colleague sends you `cleanup.py` in Slack. At this moment, what has the file done to your computer?
exercises.prompt_zh: 同事在 Slack 上发给你一个 `cleanup.py` 文件。此刻，这个文件对你的电脑做了什么？
options_en: Nothing — it's text sitting in a file, like an unopened recipe
It has started cleaning up files in the background
It depends on how well the code is written
options_zh: 什么都没做——它只是文件里的文字，像一张没打开的菜谱
它已经在后台开始清理文件了
取决于代码写得好不好
它已经把自己安装好了
exercises.explain_en: Code does nothing until something runs it. This distinction is also why receiving a file is safe but *running* an untrusted file is not.
exercises.explain_zh: 代码不被运行就什么都不做。这个区分也解释了为什么「收到」文件通常没事，而**运行**来路不明的文件就有风险。

exercises.prompt_en: Which of these is NOT source code?
options_en: A text file containing steps for a computer to follow
A Python script an AI agent just wrote
The number 42 shown as a result
A half-finished script that doesn't work yet
options_zh: 一个写着「让电脑照做的步骤」的文本文件
AI agent 刚写出来的一个 Python 脚本
屏幕上显示出来的结果数字 42
一个还跑不通的半成品脚本
exercises.explain_en: Source code is instructions. Data (like 42 in a table) is what instructions operate on. Broken or unfinished code is still code — being wrong doesn't make it not-code.
exercises.explain_zh: 源代码是指令；结果数字是指令跑完后留下的东西。写坏了的、没写完的代码也依然是代码——错误不改变它的身份。

exercises.prompt_en: Complete the sentence with one word: writing code creates a file; nothing happens until you ______ it.
exercises.prompt_zh: 用一个英文词补全（就是这一课讲的「运行 / 执行」）：写代码只是得到一个文件；直到你 ______ 它，才会真的发生事情。
exercises.explain_en: Run / execute — the moment instructions actually happen. Keep this word pair; you'll see both constantly in agent transcripts.
exercises.explain_zh: run / execute（运行 / 执行）——指令真正发生的那一刻。记住这一对词：agent 的会话记录里，这两个词都很常见。

exercises.prompt_en: An agent reports: "I created `rename_files.py` but have not run it yet." What is the best next question?
exercises.prompt_zh: agent 汇报："I created `rename_files.py` but have not run it yet."（我创建了 `rename_files.py`，但还没有运行。）你最该问什么？
options_en: Show me what the script plans to change before you run it.
Great, so the files are already renamed.
No need to review anything because it has not run.
options_zh: 先给我看它准备改哪些东西，再运行。
很好，所以文件已经改名完成了。
既然还没运行，就完全不用看。
exercises.explain_en: Nothing has changed yet, so this is the cheap moment to review intent. The collaboration move is: inspect before action.
exercises.explain_zh: 还没运行，就还没改东西；这正是最便宜的检查时刻。协作动作是：先看意图，再让它动手。

why_en: Why first: collaboration starts by separating a written artifact from an executed action.
why_zh: 为什么先学这个：协作判断的第一步，是分清「写出来了」和「已经做了」。
